name: Ginkou
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood bank branch: an ATM-maintenance notice, a first day helping at the counter, a guide to opening an account, a holiday business-hours change notice, a new-staff training plan comparison, an essay about noticing a regular customer's change in habit after learning a smartphone app from a grandchild, a lesson teaching a new part-timer how to count coins and use the coin-exchange machine, an explainer on why staffed counters are still needed in the smartphone-banking era, a free smartphone-banking consultation application guide, a column on how mobile payments changed the counter staff's work, a new-semester student account-opening rule new standard, a column on the meaning of a veteran teller's skill for spotting suspicious transactions, and a one-year cooperation report with the local shopping district association. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
